content: Pana soo nana Ananias mee naneadu, ka tu nodukwa Sapphira mee naneadu-no tu hemma-ma tumukwatekwu.
Ka tu nodukwa-no oo nanenagana naamookwitoo mu hemekwu mee tunetamma. Ka oona mu tuukwewabe nobe-kwi petugase, a naamookwitusoo mu hemese, mee mu netamma, “No'oko nu mu hemekoo.”

Soo Peter yise meeoo oo netamma, “How u yise manena u ka sutakoo nakabetsea? U yise ka Te Naa Besa Pooha nemooagana oo-matu manumaku ka tubewa-koobatoo, ne esayaekute, ‘No'oko numme mu hemekoo,’ mee ne tuukwena.
Mummetu uga soo tubewabe ka gisoo oo-ma u tumu'u. Ka tubewabe-ma mu tumuse, soo mu natumunagakuna mummetu mani. Haoo u manena suda manakwe?

U Te Naa nemooaga, gi ka mu nanana suu'mu.” Ka meeoo na'unnedu soo Ananias nakase, ya'ehoose, aanooaka. Mu tootooebetse yise oo maputooehoose, oo hanegase, oo tugutooa. No'yoona umu oo nakadu unu sua'e.
Ka saa'a manekese soo Ananias nodukwa Sapphira oe petuoo. Gisoo tu kooma ya'e-kwitu naka.
Soo Peter yise meeoo oo tubenga, “Mow haa'a yise no'yoona mu natumanakakuna ka tubewabe-kwitu mu nahemmana?” “Aha, yow sapa ne hemmana,” mee'e soo Sapphira esiyihoo.

Soo Peter yise meeoo oo netamma, “How manena mu ka Te Naa Besa Pooha soomapoonnetu-kwa'ne manakwe, ka Te Naa gi how mumme oo yukwe sapa?” Soo Peter yise meeoo, “Umu u kooma tugumodu mi pudu tzoonooagena, umu tuwazoo ume ooosoo yugwekwu.”
O'no yise Sapphira ya'ehoo, ka Peter-kumabatoo aanooaka. Mu tootooebetse oe tzoonooa petudu mooasoo oo ya'epu oo mayuoo petu. Umu yise oo tzakwuhukase, oona oo kooma-kumabasoo oo tugu.
No'yoona mu tunaka'oedyukudu ekow nakase, umu unu nakasui.
Ka ewow tu nanumu poonnena mu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe ewow numu mabesakute. Mu numu nanatabooegea besa nanano nanesootuhina, oona ka Solomon mee naneadu haba-wi ka Jew nanesootuhi nobe-kumaba.
Ewa'yoo mu numu yise Te Pabe'e unnena naka'oedyuku petuga. Gi haga oo sukwe manakwe, umu tubetse manedu. Mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu meeoo nananetamma, “Umu besa ka Te Naa oo naka'oedyukuna.”
Oona puuwana po-kumaba mu numu tu pupua'amu tuoegoedu tzapokwakute, wegea-kooba tuwow. Ka Peter o-toogoo mea, sumuna o habagana wumase, sumuna besa manekwu mee sokwamana.
Ewa'yoo numu petudyakwe Jerusalem-kumaba nonobe-ga'yoo tuutooe ka mu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe besa tuukwena nakana. Umu mu pupua'amu tuoegoedu yise namagwetzoi.
Soo mu Jew pabe'e ka tu pupua'amu-no unu ka Peter noko John nuusookwedakute.
Umuoo ka mu Peter noko John pabenase umu nuudumedahoo.
O'no togano soo Te Naa tummatziwabe toha kasa-ga'yoo ka Peter noko John-baa wue petuse ka tukwutuma nobe natzakwona'a tzakwonow. Mu Peter noko John oekoo bihookase, meeoo mu netamma,
“Ka nanesootuhi nobe-kumabatoo memeahoo. Mu sakwa ka Te Pabe'e Jesus mumme magwetzoidyi-kwitu mu numu tuukwekwu.”

Tu tabuagena, oona nanesootuhi nobe-kobena pepetugase, mu numu tunedyoo'e. Mu nanesootuhi pabe'e ka tu pupua'amu-no sumuhoo petuga, mu Jew tutunehanedu-no yise tunehane. Mu tutukwutumadu taya oona tukwutuma nobe-kwitoo mu Peter noko John mu bi tuunguna.
Ka mu tutukwutumadu oona tukwutuma nobe-kwi petugase, mu Peter-no John kadoo oetu. Punowsoo mease, ka mu tutunehanedu meeoo tuukwe,
“Numme ka tukwutuma nobe natzepunnoe oo mayu ka tukwutumadu tooesoo tu'eya'ekatu, pana mu Peter-no John kadoo oetu.”
Soo mu Jew pabe'e-no soo nanesootuhi nobe-kooba tukwutumadu naa mu naka, howga mu Peter noko John mani howgena hee manekwu ka yoo hemma manise?
Sumu'yoo yise petuoose, mu tunehane-kwi'yoona meeoo unakwe, “Yow meno'o mu Peter-no John mu tukwutumana ka nanesootuhi nobe-kobena'yoona mu numu tunedyooe.”
Mu tukwutumadu naa mu susumudu tukwutumadu-no mea'ase, mu Peter noko John bihoodooa. Mu tukwutumadu gi mu tubetse manoyukwe mu numu-ma su'ina, mu numu sumuna tupe-ma mu tapagetana mu tagoehoodooa.
Mu numu pabe'e meeoo ka mu Peter noko John netamma,
“Numme mooasoo meeoo mu netammapu, ‘Gi ka Jesus-witu numu tunedyooepana.’ Pana mu no'oko numu Jerusalem-witu ekow tunedyooe. Mu yise ka Jesus nabatsa-kwi numme oe neyugwe.”
Soo Peter yise ka umu susumudu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe-no ka mu numu tutunehanedu meeoo netamma, “Tamme sakwa Te Naa unnena mayoho gi mumme sukwe unnena.

Te nanamooatupu pumatoo nanetzakwiyina soo Te Naa ka Te Pabe'e tamme-matoo tayapu. Mu ka sunngabe namadabue-ma oo tzakwenese, oo batsapu. Soo Te Naa ka Te Pabe'e Jesus ya'e-kwikoo mayoduse numu oo moohe tuungupu. Ka mu numu suda tumadugupu mu nemawuni tuunguna, o'no yise soo Te Naa ka suda mu tumudugupu soomu'wu. Soo Te Naa ka Te Pabe'e numu oo magwetzoi tuungu.
Numme ooosapa mu numu tuukweno'o soo Te Naa yise ka tu Besa Pooha-ma mu tunaka'oedyukudu sootuhi. Soo Te Naa Besa Pooha ka mu numu tzapoonnekute Te Pabe'e pooha-ga'yoo.”
Mu tutunehanedu nakasuta'a, ka mu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe batsakwu ka mee mu tunetamma.

Soo nana Gamaliel mee naneadu ka nananesootuhidu Pharisee mee nananeadu-matu yotsehoo. Esoo nana numu nanesootuhi tunedyooedu, yise no'yoona numu oo toge'yookute ka besa-tamme. Soo Gamaliel ka mu tutukwutumadu ka mu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe oetu tzadyuba tuunguse.
O'no yise ka mu tutunehanedu meeoo netamma, “E nanumu, ka mu naana-witu mu tunemadabuepu-witu soohane.
Ewa natomose soo nana Theudas mee naneadu mee'e unakwe, ‘Nu tubetse naduyadu.’ Yise ewa'yoo (400) nanana oo nagemo'o. Ka saa'a oo nabatsase, umu oo nagemodu nanapokise.
Ka saa'a ka mu numu nadatsu'nga, soo nana Judas mee naneadu oona Galilee tubewabe-witu kemmana mu numu, ‘E nage’ mee mu netamma. Oosoo punno'o nabatsase, umu oo nagemodu nanapokise.
Mu sakwa yise meno'o umuoo naana gi matzamapana. Mu tzama'wu. Ka sukwe numu unnena suu'mu oosoo gi hee.
Soo Te Naa ka mu tummatzina mu gi hownnekoo how mu yugwe-wa'ne mu ka Te Naa tumoo'oogana.”

Oo unne-kwa'nesoo umu manakwe ka mu Peter noko John oetu bise, ka tukwutumadu umu wupageta tuungu. Umu tutunehanedu meeoo yise mu Peter noko John netamma, “Gi Jesus-witu mu numu tuukwepana.” Mu yise natzama'wu.
Mu Peter-no John yise mu tunehanedu-baa'yoona nemeahoo. Besa sokwamana, “Ta tookwa besa'yoo, o'no ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-koobatoo nuupageta,” mee yise unnemo.
Ka nanesootuhi nobe-kobena nono'otsa sumuyakwe oona numu nobe-kwi tuwazoo. Umu ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-witu numu tunedyooena, yise no'oko numu ka Jesus Te Pabe'e-witu tuukwe.
